messages.text: im feel so fear of my exam

I'm really sorry to hear that you're feeling this way. Exam anxiety can be very common during school or college years. It's normal to feel anxious about tests, but there are ways to manage it.

Firstly, try to relax. Take deep breaths, think of your test as an opportunity to learn and grow rather than a threat to your future. You don't have to pass everything, just do your best!

Secondly, prepare ahead of time. Review your notes, practice past exams, and study with friends. This will help you feel more confident and prepared for the actual test day.

Thirdly, consider talking to someone you trust. It might be a teacher, counselor,

If you find it difficult to talk about it, you can also reach out to a professional like a psychologist or therapist who specializes in helping people deal with stress and anxiety. They can provide strategies and tools to help you manage your feelings better.

Lastly, if you feel yourself becoming too overwhelmed, it might be helpful to take breaks or schedule a quiet time to relax. Remember, it's okay to ask for support when you need it!
